note: header navigation and controls -- platform's own interface including logo, app name, settings menu, and search box
app navigation sidebar -- operator-defined navigation items including Files, Favorites, Shared with me, Shared with others, Shared links, System tags, Trashbin, and Settings
app settings header -- settings button control
view switcher controls -- gallery button and loading state
create actions -- new file/folder button and upload progress controls
file table controls and column headers -- renders column titles, sort controls, select all checkbox; file list rows are subtracted as they contain user-generated file names
favorite action button -- operator control for marking files or folders as favorites
share action button -- operator control for sharing files or folders
more action menu button -- operator control for file/folder actions menu
file size cells -- computed operator-defined values for file sizes
date cells -- computed operator-defined values for file modification dates and timestamps
